warning: These are Pyragogy research candidates, not validated AI best practices.

patterns.name: Friction Before Delegation
patterns.problem: AI can turn a provisional suggestion into action before a person or group has examined assumptions, alternatives, or consequences.
patterns.intervention: Before materially consequential delegation, require an explicit checkpoint for goal, assumptions, alternatives, reversibility, and stop conditions.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: forced articulation → detection of unexamined assumptions → more deliberate delegation
failure_hypotheses: checkpoint becomes ritual clicking
users route around the friction
friction is imposed on trivial reversible actions
patterns.research_question: When does pre-delegation friction improve judgment enough to justify its cost, and when does it merely slow competent action?

patterns.name: Provenance Before Persuasion
patterns.problem: Fluent AI output can make weakly supported claims feel stronger than their evidence.
patterns.intervention: Expose claim-level provenance, evidence relation, and relevant limitations before or alongside persuasive recommendation language.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: traceable support → easier challenge and verification → reduced conflation of fluency with evidence
failure_hypotheses: citation theatre
source dumping without entailment
users ignore provenance under time pressure
patterns.research_question: Which provenance displays actually change verification behaviour rather than merely increasing perceived credibility?

patterns.name: Bounded AI Mandate
patterns.problem: Agents can accumulate practical authority without an explicit domain, duration, revocation rule, or accountable principal.
patterns.intervention: Define an AI agent's domain, permissions, duration, budget, escalation triggers, and revocation path before autonomous execution.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: explicit mandate → inspectable authority → easier correction and revocation
failure_hypotheses: formal mandate diverges from effective permissions
credential control creates hidden authority
revocation exists on paper but is operationally difficult
patterns.research_question: Do explicit agent mandates reduce authority drift in real workflows, and which controls matter most?

patterns.name: Reversible Automation
patterns.problem: Automation can make errors costly because actions are difficult to inspect, undo, or attribute after execution.
patterns.intervention: Prefer staged, logged, reversible actions with preview, rollback, or bounded blast radius when the task permits it.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: reversibility + traceability → cheaper error recovery → safer local experimentation
failure_hypotheses: rollback gives false confidence
irreversible side effects remain outside the logged system
humans stop reviewing because rollback exists
patterns.research_question: How much does reversibility improve error recovery and willingness to experiment without increasing reckless delegation?

patterns.name: Escalation Ladder for Autonomy
patterns.problem: AI systems are often given either too little agency to be useful or too much agency before their local reliability is known.
patterns.intervention: Increase autonomy by explicit levels tied to task class, observed performance, failure severity, reversibility, and supervision requirements.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: graded authority → evidence gathered at lower-risk levels → better calibrated autonomy
failure_hypotheses: level inflation without evidence
metrics optimise easy tasks rather than consequential ones
exceptions silently become the new default
patterns.research_question: What evidence should justify moving an AI agent from advice to execution, and when should autonomy be reduced again?

patterns.name: Preserve Dissent Through Synthesis
patterns.problem: AI summarisation can erase minority objections by compressing disagreement into an apparently unified group position.
patterns.intervention: Represent unresolved objections, minority positions, and decision-relevant disagreement explicitly rather than merging them into consensus prose.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: visible dissent → preserved contrary information → fewer false-consensus decisions
failure_hypotheses: token preservation without influence
minority views are over-amplified as false balance
AI invents disagreement that was not expressed
patterns.research_question: Can AI-mediated synthesis preserve decision-relevant dissent without overwhelming groups or manufacturing symmetry?

patterns.name: Separate Observation, Interpretation, and Recommendation
patterns.problem: AI responses often blend extracted facts, inference, and advice, making it difficult to locate where disagreement begins.
patterns.intervention: Maintain explicit boundaries between observed/retrieved material, interpretation, and recommended action.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: layer separation → easier contestation → more localised correction
failure_hypotheses: labels create false certainty
users ignore distinctions
interpretation leaks into supposedly observational text
patterns.research_question: Does explicit layer separation improve error detection and disagreement quality in human–AI work?

patterns.name: Scoped Memory
patterns.problem: Persistent AI memory can import stale, irrelevant, or contextually inappropriate assumptions into later work.
patterns.intervention: Attach memory to an explicit scope, provenance, review path, and where appropriate an expiry or revalidation condition.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: bounded persistence → fewer hidden context transfers → more inspectable continuity
failure_hypotheses: scope metadata is ignored
important continuity is lost
incorrect memory persists because nobody owns review
patterns.research_question: Which memory boundaries reduce harmful context carryover without destroying useful organisational continuity?

patterns.name: Handoff With Epistemic Debt
patterns.problem: Human-to-AI and agent-to-agent handoffs often pass conclusions while dropping assumptions, unresolved questions, counterevidence, and uncertainty.
patterns.intervention: Require handoffs to include what is known, inferred, unresolved, contradicted, and still awaiting verification.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: explicit unresolved state → less false closure → better downstream verification
failure_hypotheses: handoff template becomes boilerplate
uncertainty accumulates without ownership
downstream agents discard caveats
patterns.research_question: Which handoff fields prevent compounding error across multi-step human–AI and agentic workflows?

patterns.name: Independence Before Multi-Agent Consensus
patterns.problem: Multiple AI outputs can create an illusion of independent confirmation even when agents share models, prompts, sources, retrieval, or inherited reasoning.
patterns.intervention: Record independence across model, prompt, data, retrieval, toolchain, and prior-agent context before treating convergence as corroboration.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: visible dependency → reduced false replication → better interpretation of agreement
failure_hypotheses: nominally different agents share hidden training or retrieval dependencies
independence metadata becomes impossible to audit
diversity is optimised for disagreement rather than accuracy
patterns.research_question: When does multi-agent agreement provide information beyond repeated sampling from a shared dependency structure?

patterns.name: Name the Accountable Human Authority
patterns.problem: AI involvement can diffuse responsibility until nobody is clearly accountable for a consequential group decision or action.
patterns.intervention: For consequential actions, record the person or governance body with authority to approve, stop, revise, or own the outcome.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: named authority → contestable responsibility → clearer escalation and redress
failure_hypotheses: nominal owner lacks real power
accountability is used to centralise all decisions
rubber-stamp approval hides de facto automation
patterns.research_question: Which forms of named human accountability create real control rather than ceremonial sign-off?

patterns.name: Close the AI Advice Loop
patterns.problem: AI recommendations are often consumed without recording what was tried or whether the predicted benefit occurred.
patterns.intervention: Convert a recommendation into a bounded experiment with expected outcome, observation window, cost record, and revision decision.
patterns.proposed_mechanism: prediction + observation → local feedback → updated reliance and pattern knowledge
failure_hypotheses: only successes are recorded
outcomes are too vague to falsify
measurement burden kills experimentation
patterns.research_question: Can outcome-tracked AI advice improve local calibration and convert usage into reusable organisational evidence?
